description: EQClinic is a web-based teleconsultation-practice platform developed by Liu and colleagues for recording standardized-patient consultations and generating automated nonverbal-behavior feedback for medical communication training.
title: EQClinic

description: Equatio is Texthelp's digital mathematics equation editor and accessibility tool, while Mathspace is a digital workspace for working with equations, shapes, and freehand drawings; teachers and students use them in mathematics instruction.
title: Equatio and Mathspace

description: A classroom observation protocol developed by Marshall and colleagues that rates inquiry-based instruction across instruction, assessment, discourse, and curriculum on a four-level scale.
title: EQUIP (Electronic Quality of Inquiry Protocol)

description: The Equitized Syllabus is a shared syllabus template developed and standardized by BMCC for adoption across course sections and partner colleges.
title: Equitized Syllabus

description: A computing-equity planning framework developed by Li et al.
title: Equity-5C (E-5C) model for computing education

description: A research-informed framework developed by Rutherford et al.
title: Equity, Agency and Transparency (EAT) framework

description: A proposed community-college edtech evaluation and procurement framework from Van Nostrand et al.
title: Equity-centered, vendor-accountable edtech evaluation system model

description: Duong et al.'s E-EMR is a professional-development framework that guides teachers through Establish, Maintain, and Restore relationship practices while embedding equity levers to support racially minoritized students.
title: Equity-Explicit Establish-Maintain-Restore (E-EMR)
